scope: Synthetic seed-777, post-study kernel diagnostics; no study data or checkpoints. Native buffers and ctypes pointers are preallocated; one CPU compute thread. Every observation includes Python/FFI or PyTorch dispatch. No FFI subtraction. Native backward repeats reuse saved activations and accumulate parameter gradients. PyTorch timings run under inference_mode, with no autograd graph. Component times cannot be treated as additive runtime shares or as replacements for matched-study timings. The PyTorch loss-only case excludes the gradient produced by native loss.
order_rule: Paired forward/reverse blocks, rotated left by block index // 2
